name: Agrus Kos
description: Agrus Kos is a human Boros and Wojek investigator on Ravnica who arrested Szadek and broke the Guildpact, and who returned as a ghost.

description_citations.text: "Agrus Kos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Agrus Kos is a human Boros and Wojek investigator on Ravnica who arrested Szadek and broke the Guildpact, and who returned as a ghost.

citations.text: "Agrus Kos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Abandoned at Tin Street Market as a child and raised in an orphanage, he was inspired by a Wojek who stopped Gruul raiders to join the force.

citations.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Agrus Kos", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At the Decamillennial he and Jarad stopped Szadek's plan to kill Mat'Selesnya, and Kos arrested Szadek, which unwittingly broke the Guildpact.

citations.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ravnica", section "The Decamillennial". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Dissension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Overwhelmed by acclaim, he retired to become an Orzhov security guard in Utvara, then helped Teysa and allies stop Zomaj Hauc's plan to hatch dragon eggs, and died in the process.

citations.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Retirement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Agrus Kos", section "Retirement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Agrus Kos", section "Retirement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Zomaj Hauc", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The Azorius brought his spirit back inside borrowed bodies, and Kos killed Momir Vig and trapped Szadek in a grounder before Szadek killed Augustin IV.

citations.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Momir Vig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Feather brought his spirit back as a spirit officer for the Wojek in Agyrem, where he was also appointed Szadek's warden.

citations.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Szadek", section "Death and reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Karlov Manor case he was assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency as a ghost, found Rakdos asleep in his lava pit, and was trapped by Judith in a crystal skull.

citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

status.text: Agrus Kos is a ghost last shown imprisoned in Judith's crystal skull during the Karlov Manor case, and the material does not say how he was freed.

citations.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Judith", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
On the Job (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos describes finding a victim drained to a sack of skin and robes.
timeline.quote: As it turned out, it *was* the victim, insides sucked out—just a sack of skin and robes.

citation.text: Disembowel (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Zomaj Hauc tries to revive ancient dragon eggs on Ravnica but is foiled.
timeline.quote: Zomaj Hauc tried to revive several ancient dragon eggs some years after the Decamillennial

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact, exploiting a loophole that broke the Guildpact's spell.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact

citation.text: "Guildpact (spell)", section "The original Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing Szadek and House Dimir to the public.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek, which exposed him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek is arrested by Agrus Kos and imprisoned by the Azorius, who secretly execute him.
timeline.quote: imprisoned by the Azorius who secretly executes him

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Decamillennial, Agrus Kos arrests the Dimir head Szadek and unwittingly breaks the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: the Guildpact was unwittingly broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Decamillennial". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vig allies with Svogthir to activate Project Kraj and is killed by Agrus Kos.
timeline.quote: He was consequently killed by Agrus Kos .

citation.text: "Simic Combine", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos advises that the first blow is most important.
timeline.quote: The first blow is the most important.

citation.text: Fencer's Magemark (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gruul ravage the streets while Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to cleanse them.
timeline.quote: Teysa leads the Orzhov Syndicate to "cleanse" them.

citation.text: "Guildpact", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa and Melisk bring Uncle's corpse into Pivlic's bar where Kos works.
timeline.quote: carrying the corpse of Uncle, who was killed during the Gruul attack.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos studies the Schism and sees the Kuga mot while searching for Feather and Parhelion.
timeline.quote: The Kuga Mot appears, a mysterious glowing sphere or apparition

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa sends Pivlic, Kos and the Grugg Brothers to rescue Crix; Nebun reveals he always had a cure and Teysa buys it.
timeline.quote: Nebun reveals that he had a cure for the Kuga all along.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crix and Kos's parties flee Aun Yom's party and realize they are zombies.
timeline.quote: figure out that they are actually zombies along the way.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos and the others find Hauc trying to hatch three dragon eggs to destroy the Guildpact; he orders them killed.
timeline.quote: Hauc is trying to get three dragon eggs to hatch.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a dogfight Hauc dies; the two dragons kill each other.
timeline.quote: The two dragons kill each other

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos is impaled in the crash, sees Feather emerge from the kuga mot, and dies.
timeline.quote: and Agrus Kos passes away.

citation.text: "Guildpact (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, which technically breaks the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Agrus Kos stepped forward to formally arrest the vampire

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aftermath: Jarad becomes Golgari guildmaster, Kos prepares to leave the force, and Luda's body is revealed to be a Lupul.
timeline.quote: Jarad rising as the new Golgari guildmaster

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos publicly arrests Szadek, finally breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing House Dimir.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell is finally broken when he publicly arrests Szadek , exposing him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "Dissension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Azorius place Kos's spirit in the body of ectomancer Obez Murzeddi.
timeline.quote: The Azorius put the spirit of Agrus Kos inside the body of an Azorius ectomancer named Obez Murzeddi .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Augustin tells Kos he broke the Guildpact by arresting Szadek.
timeline.quote: Kos broke the Guildpact.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Evern warns Kos and Augustin that Momir Vig and the Simic work with the God-Zombie Svogthir in Savra's body.
timeline.quote: Evern Capobar shows up to warn them about Momir Vig and the Simic, who are working together with the God-Zombie Svogthir who was inhabiting the body of Savra.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 10". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Momir Vig explains that the dragon's fluid was needed to complete Experiment Kraj.
timeline.quote: explains how the dragon's cerebral fluid was needed to complete the Experiment Kraj .

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 14". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos transfers into Savra's corpse, overpowering Svogthir, and kills Momir Vig before he can control Kraj.
timeline.quote: but then Kos kills Vig before he can take control of Kraj completely.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 16". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Augustin reveals he took control of the captured Szadek and wants a new Ravnica where everyone follows the law.
timeline.quote: Augstin wants to create a new Ravnica, where everyone follows the law.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 18". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek, released from Kos's grounder, sucks Augustin's soul out, then the Parhelion explodes.
timeline.quote: When Szadek erupts from his prison, he immediately recognizes Augustin and sucks his soul right out of his body.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 18". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two years later Kos is brought back to Ravnica as a ghost with a semi-corporeal body.
timeline.quote: Two years later the new Azorius guildmaster, on behalf of Feather (who has become the new Boros guildmaster), manages to bring Kos back to Ravnica.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact is created, the Schism fades and Agyrem overlays Ravnica; Kos becomes Boros commander there.
timeline.quote: Kos accepts the task of becoming the Boros commander for that area.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos kills Momir Vig, Kraj falls, Rakdos is badly damaged and Izolda is torn apart by her cultists; Rakdos falls into a coma.
timeline.quote: However, Vig was killed by Agrus Kos and Kraj fell later, during the fight.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Dissension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos overpowers Svogthir's mind and kills Vig, then Kraj destroys Vig's lab with Svogthir inside; his fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: His fate after this is unknown

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Last sighting". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agyrem overlays Ravnica as the Ghost Quarter and Agrus Kos returns as a ghost to lead its police force.
timeline.quote: The rise of Agyrem also marked the return of Agrus Kos , brought back as a ghost.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos describes the weight of strength and pride in a Boros signet.
timeline.quote: Have you ever held a Boros signet?

citation.text: Boros Signet (Planechase, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Fonn brings Bayul to the mortuary with Agrus Kos; Bayul gives her the communication gem.
timeline.quote: Bayul woke just long enough to give his instructions to Fonn

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fonn learns the truth about her father's death from Kos.
timeline.quote: She learned that truth from Kos after the Decamillennial disaster

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos blows up Old Prahv, leaving a blast crater.
timeline.quote: an arena about the size of the blast crater from when Agrus Kos blew up Old Prahv .

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "Areas of unknown allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Judith frames Rakdos for the Karlov Manor murders, imprisoning Agrus Kos who found Rakdos asleep.
timeline.quote: Judith imprisoned Kos, leaving nobody who could advocate for the demon's innocence.

citation.text: "Rakdos (character)", section "Persecution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrives, assigned by the Boros to work alongside the Agency.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion has asked me to work alongside the Agency doing whatever they feel is necessary to catch the party or parties responsible.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 4: Justice before Mercy" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim tells Kaya that Teysa's killer has been caught by the Azorius.
timeline.quote: Teysa's killer has been apprehended by the Azorius.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos backs Kaya's plea and Aurelia grants twenty-four hours.
timeline.quote: Twenty-four hours, no more, and the assassin stays with us

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 6: Explosions of Genius" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos tells Kaya he must investigate alone, because it is too dangerous for a living person.
timeline.quote: this is too dangerous for a living person

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos descends to Rakdos's lava pit and finds the demon asleep under dust and moss.
timeline.quote: Rakdos lay curled at the burning center of the lava, eyes closed, seeming oddly peaceful.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Judith captures Agrus Kos in a crystal skull.
timeline.quote: Judith stepped out of the shadows, a crystal skull in her hands, smirking at the place where he had been.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Judith reveals she is planting clues to frame Rakdos and take over the guild.
timeline.quote: All I need to do is throw enough clues in front of those amateur crime-chasers, and this ends with me at center stage.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Aurelia storms in and declares the Boros Legion at war with the Rakdos Cult.
timeline.quote: The Boros Legion marches to war.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya, Kellan and Agrus Kos agree to seek justice for Teysa's murderer.
timeline.quote: none of them would rest until Teysa's murderer was brought to justice.

citation.text: On the Job (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Judith's plan nears fruition and she cannot let Agrus interfere.
timeline.quote: Judith's plan was close to fruition. She couldn't have Agrus get in the way.

citation.text: Soul Enervation (Murders at Karlov Manor, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kos's mother abandons him at the Tin Street Market and he grows up in an orphanage.
timeline.quote: His mother dumped Agrus in the Tin Street Market as a child of unknown age

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An unnamed Wojek stops Gruul raiders from burning down the orphanage, inspiring Kos to join the Wojek.
timeline.quote: they were single-handedly stopped by an unnamed Wojek

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Childhood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Kos's first case Zunich mistakenly kills a little girl used as bait for Palla.
timeline.quote: Zunich was too eager to get the cultist and mistakenly attacked and killed a little girl

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zunich tries to kill Jarad as the sole witness; Kos intervenes and Zunich falls to his death.
timeline.quote: Zunich slipped off the roof and was killed on impact

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos is forced into a promotion, learning Bell Borca was meant to replace him, and Borca dies after discovering a world-threatening conspiracy.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately for Borca, that discovery cost him his life.

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek triggers his plan to kill Mat'Selesnya at the Decamillennial; Jarad and Kos stop it and Kos arrests the Dimir guildleader.
timeline.quote: Kos arrested the Dimir guildleader to answer for his crimes

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Life in the Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Overwhelmed by acclaim, Kos retires from the Wojek and becomes an Orzhov security guard in Utvara.
timeline.quote: he chose to step down from the Wojeks and disappear into the lesser districts of Ravnica

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Retirement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teysa, Kos and allies infiltrate the Cauldron to stop Zomaj's plan to hatch dragon eggs.
timeline.quote: the group infiltrated the Cauldron to stop Zomaj

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Retirement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group kills the dragon and the archmage, but Kos dies when Crixizix's healing teardrop triggers his condition.
timeline.quote: he died because of the teardrop Crixizix used, trying to save him

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Retirement". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos's spirit is forced to serve as an Azorius Senate spirit guard, and Augustin IV brings him back to stop Szadek.
timeline.quote: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV brought him back for the sole purpose of stopping Szadek

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos possesses a Virusoid guard to enter Novijen and kills Momir Vig, too late to stop Project Kraj.
timeline.quote: Kos was left with little choice and killed the mad genius

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kos traps Szadek in a grounder, then throws it at Augustin, freeing Szadek who kills Augustin by removing his soul.
timeline.quote: causing Szadek to break out of the container and kill Augustin by removing his soul

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather brings Kos's spirit back as a spirit officer for the Wojek in Agyrem.
timeline.quote: his spirit was brought back by Feather, who recruited him as a spirit officer for the Wojek

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Afterlife". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Karlov Manor case Kos is trapped in a crystal skull by Judith and left there.
timeline.quote: he was trapped in a crystal skull by Judith

citation.text: "Agrus Kos", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Karlov Manor Zegana is assassinated and Massacre Girl attempts Aurelia's life; Kaya, Kellan and Agrus Kos win time to investigate.
timeline.quote: an attempt was made on her own life by Massacre Girl

citation.text: "Aurelia", section "Crime wave". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Judith misdirects Kaya and Kellan to implicate Rakdos, then imprisons Agrus Kos in a crystal skull.
timeline.quote: She then imprisoned Kos in a crystal skull to prevent him from interfering.

citation.text: "Judith", section "Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos and Feather publicly arrest Mr. Gullmott on stage during a production of the Signing of the Guildpact, and Yertrude vanishes from the audience, returning as a seeker ghost that Kos destroys.
timeline.quote: Kos and Feather very publicly arrested Mr. Gullmott while he was enraged and enchanted on-stage in a production of the Signing of the Guildpact .

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The goblin assassin detonates a bomb at Aul House, killing himself, Bayul and Borca; Kos survives and Fonn is removed to the Undercity by Jarad vod Savo.
timeline.quote: The goblin assassin then detonated a bomb, killing himself, Bayul, and Borca in the blast.

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hauc betrays Niv-Mizzet and the hatchlings are killed by Teysa Karlov, Agrus Kos and friends.
timeline.quote: the hatchlings were killed by Teysa Karlov , Agrus Kos , and their friends

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos apprehends Szadek, who is banished into Agyrem, laid over Ravnica as the Schism is healed.
timeline.quote: the vampire was banished into Agyrem

citation.text: "Agyrem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Kos kills Momir Vig, the senate votes to place Ravnica under martial law under Augustin.
timeline.quote: they voted to place Ravnica under martial law under his guidance

citation.text: "Augustin IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szadek breaks free and kills Augustin IV by tearing out his soul before the Parhelion explodes.
timeline.quote: Szadek broke free from the container and killed Augustin IV by tearing out his soul

citation.text: "Augustin IV", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crix becomes lost when Gruul attack Teysa Karlov's lokopede, then reaches the Cauldron with help from Vor Golozar, Agrus Kos and Pivlic.
timeline.quote: she was able to reach the Cauldron and deliver her message

citation.text: "Crixizix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crix defies Hauc and saves Agrus Kos from the Cauldron explosion.
timeline.quote: Crix defied her master and tried to stop him.

citation.text: "Crixizix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Decamillennial, Kos frees her wings and she vanishes looking for the Parhelion.
timeline.quote: Kos freed her wings and she vanished, looking for the missing Parhelion

citation.text: "Feather", section "Wojek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feather returns on sensing Kos's death and is chosen as a pallbearer.
timeline.quote: She reappeared when she sensed Kos's death.

citation.text: "Feather", section "Guildmaster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vig is killed by Agrus Kos and Rakdos is trapped within Kraj, suffering extensive damage.
timeline.quote: Vig was killed by Agrus Kos

citation.text: "Izolda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Opposed to his twin Savra, Jarad allies with Agrus Kos and Fonn Zunich and upsets Szadek's coup at the Decamillennial Festival; after Savra dies he takes control of the Golgari Swarm.
timeline.quote: he took control of the Golgari Swarm

citation.text: "Jarad vod Savo", section "Bounty hunter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos kills Vig by stabbing him in the eye.
timeline.quote: slew Vig by stabbing him in the eye

citation.text: "Momir Vig", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos stops the plan but the Parhelion is destroyed.
